data.name: Ilhaan
data.gender_notes: Ilhaan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ilhaan is an Arabic name that means inner light or radiance. It refers to the divine light that shines within every individual, guiding them and helping them connect with their higher selves. The name Ilhaan carries the meaning “Inner Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Ilhaan usually hope their child will grow to embody inner light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ilhaan is a reminder to nurture and embrace one's inner light, allowing it to guide and illuminate one's path in life.
data.etymology: Ilhaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Inner Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ilhaan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: إلهان
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإلهان: اسم علم مشتق من الربيع، حيث يرمز إلى الفوضى الجديدة، ويأتي من الجذر الإلهي، وتعني المباركة والمقدسة والمطهّرة، ويُعتبر إلهان اسمًا علميًا مقدسًا في الإسلام، حيث يرمز إلى الكمال والتوحيد، ويُعتبر مصدرًا للفضائل والجود، ويُستخدم للإشارة إلى الشخص المبارك والمقدس.

in_urdu.name: ایلھان
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایلھان: ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربي زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مبارک، مقدس اور تمیز یافتہ، اس نام کا تعلق رباعی سے ہے جہاں اس کا معنی فضا اور پاکیزگی ہے، مسلمان والدین ایک شاندار نام ہونے کی وجہ سے اس نام کا انتخاب کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: इल्हान
in_hindi.long_meaning: इल्हान: यह एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, इसका अर्थ है मुबारक, मुकद्दस और त्मयित हुआ, इस नाम का संबंध रबई से है, जहां इसका अर्थ है फजा, और पवित्रता, भारतीय मुसलमान अभी भी इस नाम का इस्तेमाल करते हैं, और इसे शानदार नाम मानते हैं.

in_pashto.name: ایلھان
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایلھان: ځانګړي نوم دی چې د عربي څخه راغلی دی، د هغه معنی د فضا او پاکوالی دی، پخواني افغانانو لپاره دا نوم ځانګړی دی، او دا دویو شانديړو نوم دی.

in_english.name: Ilhaan
in_english.long_meaning: Ilhaan: an Arabic name derived from the root 'al-rabi' meaning spring, symbolizing new beginnings, and is associated with the divine, meaning blessed, sacred, and pure. In Islamic tradition, Ilhaan is considered a sacred name, representing perfection and unity, and is seen as a source of virtues and generosity. It is used to refer to a person who is blessed, sacred, and pure, and is often associated with qualities such as kindness and modesty.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Ilhaan represents the spiritual inner light that embodies wisdom, intuition, and enlightenment. Naming a child Ilhaan reflects the parents' hopes and aspirations for their child's personal growth and development.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Ilhaan is a reminder of the presence of the Divine Light within each human being. It encourages individuals to look within themselves for guidance, strength, and wisdom. The name Ilhaan is said to evoke a sense of inner peace, hope, and inspiration, helping the named person navigate the ups and downs of life with grace and resilience.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ilhaan: A name derived from the Arabic word 'al-ilhaan', meaning ‘the most exalted, high, or sublime’. It is a name that signifies greatness, nobility, and elevation, reminding the bearer to continually strive for excellence and transcendence in all aspects of life.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ilhaan is a variant of Alihan, mentioned in the book 'The Golden Age of the Quran' by Muhammad al-Ghazali.

trends: popular in some Muslim communities in the West
